comments: Auditzo's free Website Accessibility Scanner evaluates one publicly accessible webpage per run using automated WCAG 2.2 A/AA-oriented technical checks. Users can review findings online and download a PDF report. The scanner does not determine complete WCAG conformance. Human-reviewed audits and remediation support are separate offerings.
features: Auditzo is a free online website accessibility scanner for public webpages. It runs automated WCAG 2.2 A/AA-oriented checks for detectable issues involving structure, labels, ARIA, focus, reflow and target size. Results are available online and as a PDF. It does not determine complete WCAG conformance.
title: Auditzo Website Accessibility Scanner
